dialogue.content: おはようございます　相談員です　よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Good morning. I’m the counselor. It’s nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: さっそくですが今日はどのようなご相談で来られたのでしょうか？よければ教えて下さいますか？
dialogue.English: To begin, what brings you in today? If you’re comfortable, could you tell me a bit about it?

dialogue.content: どうしていいかわからなくて
dialogue.English: I don’t know what to do.

dialogue.content: 疲れてしまいました
dialogue.English: I'm just so tired.

dialogue.content: ふられました
dialogue.English: I got dumped.

dialogue.content: 疲れてしまう事があったのですね　辛いですよね　今日はいろいろ聴かせて下さいね　どのような事がわからなくて疲れてしまったのでしょうか？よければもう少し教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: It sounds like you’ve been through something draining. That’s really hard. Please feel free to share whatever you’d like today. What is it that feels so uncertain and exhausting? If you don’t mind, could you tell me a bit more?

dialogue.content: 職場の人と付き合ってたんですが、
dialogue.English: I was dating someone at work, but…

dialogue.content: ふられてしまったんですね　それは本当に辛いですね
dialogue.English: So you were broken up with. That must be really painful.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 相手が、同じ職場の人に乗り換えた…
dialogue.English: They left me for a coworker…

dialogue.content: 仕事してたらずっと気になってしまうし。
dialogue.English: When I’m at work, I can’t stop thinking about it.

dialogue.content: なかなか気持ちも切り替えられず、気まずいです
dialogue.English: I'm having a hard time moving on, and it's just so awkward.

dialogue.content: コロナで転職も難しいし
dialogue.English: And with COVID, it's hard to find a new job.

dialogue.content: それはショックですよね　いつも目にしているとなかなか忘れられないですし見たくないですよね…
dialogue.English: That must be a shock. When you have to see them all the time, it’s hard to forget—and it’s understandable you wouldn’t want to see them.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。早く忘れたいんです。
dialogue.English: Exactly. I just want to forget about it as soon as possible.

dialogue.content: コロナも影響しているんですね　それでもちゃんと仕事へ行ってる事は凄く頑張ってると思います
dialogue.English: So the pandemic is a factor as well. I think you're doing an amazing job just by continuing to go to work despite all this.

dialogue.content: なのにできなくて、今まで何だったんだろう、って情けないし、職場のひとの目も気になるし
dialogue.English: But I can't, and I feel pathetic wondering what our relationship was even for. I'm also worried about what my coworkers think.

dialogue.content: 私一人、バカみたい
dialogue.English: I feel like such a fool all by myself.

dialogue.content: 頑張ってなんかないです。行かなきゃお金もらえないから、ただそれだけで仕事してるだけです。やりがいなんてないし。
dialogue.English: I'm not trying hard at all. I'm just going because I need the money. There's no sense of fulfillment or anything.

dialogue.content: そうですよね　職場の人の目が気になると仕事どころじゃないですし　本当に気まずいと思います
dialogue.English: I understand. It's hard to focus on work when you're worried about what your coworkers are thinking. I can imagine it's incredibly awkward.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみに同じ職場の人に乗り換えてしまったとのこと　相手はシロクマさんの友達に盗られてしまったとかでしょうか？上司や職場の人であまり仲は良くない人にでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned they left you for another coworker. Was this person a friend of yours, Shirokuma-san, or was it a superior or a coworker you weren't particularly close with?

dialogue.content: 仲のいい人ではありません。ただの同僚。
dialogue.English: Not a close friend. Just a colleague.

dialogue.content: それからシロクマさんは全然バカじゃないですよ　お金のためとはいえ　こういう状況でも頑張れている事に変わりはありません
dialogue.English: And please know, Shirokuma-san, you are not a fool at all. Even if it's for the money, the fact remains that you are pushing through this difficult situation.

dialogue.content: 仲良い訳ではない同僚になんですね　教えて下さりありがとうございます
dialogue.English: I see, so it was a colleague you weren't close with. Thank you for sharing that.

dialogue.content: 乗り換えられたということはもともと彼女さんと付き合ってたと思うのですが　乗り換えられてしまう前に何か素振りや気配などはあったのですか？突然ですか？
dialogue.English: You said they left you for someone else. Before that happened, were there any signs or hints that something was wrong? Or did it happen suddenly?

dialogue.content: 私にとっては突然でした。全然気が付かなかった。突然、謝られて、別の人と付き合いたいって言われて。相手が同僚でした。
dialogue.English: For me, it was sudden. I didn't notice anything at all. All of a sudden, they apologized and said they wanted to date someone else. And that person was my colleague.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね　突然そんな事を云われてしまうと戸惑いますし　それはどうしていいかわからなくなってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I see. Being told something like that out of the blue must have been confusing. It's completely understandable that you wouldn't know what to do.

dialogue.content: それを突然聴いてシロクマさんはその時どのようにお返事したのですか？
dialogue.English: When you heard that suddenly, how did you respond at the time, Shirokuma-san?

dialogue.content: もう、そう言われたら別れるしかないから、いいんですけど。でも、そこから仕事をどうやってしたらいいのか、わからなくなりました。
dialogue.English: Well, when someone says that, you have no choice but to break up, so that's fine. But after that, I just didn't know how I was supposed to handle things at work.

dialogue.content: 別れたいって聞いたときはショックでした。でも、分かったって言いました。
dialogue.English: When I heard they wanted to break up, I was shocked. But I just said, 'I understand.'

dialogue.content: そう言われたら別れるしかないと思ったのは何故でしょうか？お仕事に影響出ちゃいますよね…
dialogue.English: What made you feel there was no choice but to break up when they said that? It must be affecting your work…

dialogue.content: 相手にその気がないなら、付き合い続けるのは無理ですよね。
dialogue.English: If the other person doesn't feel that way anymore, you can't force the relationship to continue, right?

dialogue.content: それは本当にその気がない感じだったのでしょうか？もしかしたら試されてるとか可能性はありませんか？
dialogue.English: Did it truly feel like they had lost interest? Is there any possibility they were testing you?

dialogue.content: こんなふうにしても引き留めてくれるか　好きって言ってくれるかって　同僚の方に協力してもらったとかは？
dialogue.English: Like, to see if you would try to stop them or say you like them, and maybe they got the coworker to help?

dialogue.content: それはないです
dialogue.English: That's not possible.

dialogue.content: それはどうしてないと言い切れるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What makes you so sure that's not the case?

dialogue.content: 嫌な事を聴いていたらすみません　答えたくなければスルーで大丈夫ですよ
dialogue.English: I'm sorry if I'm asking something unpleasant. If you don't want to answer, you don't have to.

dialogue.content: そういう人ではないし、実際にそうではないので。違います。
dialogue.English: They're not that kind of person, and that's just not what happened. It's not that.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね　失礼しました　夜はちゃんと睡眠や食事はとれていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. I apologize. Are you able to sleep and eat properly?

dialogue.content: あまり眠れないけど、ご飯は食べれています。
dialogue.English: I can't sleep much, but I am eating.

dialogue.content: ご飯食べれてる事は安心しました　でもあまり寝れないと次の日の仕事に影響でますし寝れない間いろいろ考えてしまうからお辛いですよね…職場にはこの事を相談できる方はいますか？
dialogue.English: I’m relieved to hear you’re eating. But not sleeping much can affect your work the next day, and it must be hard when your mind races while you can't sleep. Is there anyone at your workplace you can talk to about this?

dialogue.content: いないです。
dialogue.English: No, there isn't.

dialogue.content: 職場の空気を悪くした一員でもあるので、これ以上は乱したくないです。
dialogue.English: I'm one of the people who made the atmosphere at work awkward, so I don't want to stir things up any more.

dialogue.content: そう感じてしまいますよね　あまり眠れず職場でまわりの目が気になって気まずい中で相談できる方もいないのは疲れてしまうのは当然です　とても心配です
dialogue.English: It's natural to feel that way. Not being able to sleep well, feeling awkward and watched at work, and having no one to talk to—of course you're exhausted. I'm very concerned for you.

dialogue.content: ちなみに仕事はどのようなお仕事をしているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: By the way, what kind of work do you do?

dialogue.content: 今更ですみません
dialogue.English: Sorry for asking so late.

dialogue.content: 小さな商社で、私は営業です。
dialogue.English: I'm in sales at a small trading company.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます　今回このこと以外でお仕事は順調ですか？他に困ってることなどはありますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. Aside from this, is work going well? Are there any other problems you're facing?

dialogue.content: ないです。
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: 他の困ってる事はないのですね　それはよかったです
dialogue.English: So there aren’t other concerns—that’s good to hear.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: シロクマさん的には今後どうなって行ってほしい　どうしたい　どうだったらいいのにとお考えですか？
dialogue.English: From your perspective, Shirokuma-san, how would you like things to go from here? What do you want to do, and how do you wish things could be?

dialogue.content: 職場では、早く、今回ののゴタゴタがなかったことになればいいけど、そんなすぐにはならないだろうし…
dialogue.English: At work, I wish this whole mess would just go away as if it never happened, but I know that's not going to happen anytime soon...

dialogue.content: 私はやりがいとか、なくて。でも、そんなのがあってバリバリ働いている人とか、羨ましい。
dialogue.English: I don't have any passion for my work or a sense of purpose. I'm envious of people who have that and work so energetically.

dialogue.content: 時間かかりますよね…
dialogue.English: It does take time…

dialogue.content: 結婚して幸せそうな友達とか見ると、私には何にもないんだなって、虚しくなります。
dialogue.English: When I see friends who are married and look happy, I feel empty, like I have nothing.

dialogue.content: こんなゴタゴタを気にしないで、強く生きていけたらいいのにって思います。
dialogue.English: I wish I could be strong enough to live my life without worrying about this mess.

dialogue.content: 他の方を見ると羨ましくなったり嫌でも無力だって感じちゃいますよね…彼女さんのほうはシロクマさんに対して職場でどんな感じですか？
dialogue.English: It's easy to feel envious or helpless when you look at others... How has your ex been acting towards you at work?

dialogue.content: 強くなれますよ　今でもじゅうぶん強いと思います　大丈夫です
dialogue.English: You can become strong. I think you're already plenty strong right now. It's going to be okay.

dialogue.content: 何もないです。挨拶だけはお互い一応してる感じです。
dialogue.English: Nothing in particular. We just exchange greetings, out of courtesy.

dialogue.content: 挨拶だけなんですね　それは寂しいし悲しいですよね
dialogue.English: It’s just greetings then. That feels lonely and sad, doesn’t it?

dialogue.content: 元々そういう関係なので、問題ないです。
dialogue.English: Our relationship was always like that, so it's not a problem.

dialogue.content: LINEなどの連絡はもうお互い全く何もなくなったかんじですか？友達として続いていたりは？
dialogue.English: Have you completely stopped contacting each other through apps like LINE? Are you still friends?

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 仕事をする上で関わっているだけです。
dialogue.English: We only interact as needed for work.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね　今更ですが好きな人ができて乗り換えるとは聴いたものの　彼女はその同僚の方とお付き合いを始めているかんじですか？ただ一方的な彼女の片想いで　彼女の想いが強くて言われたかんじだったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. I know this is late to ask, but when they said they were leaving you for someone they liked, did you get the sense that they had already started dating that colleague? Or was it more like it was a one-sided crush on their part, and they told you because their feelings were so strong?

dialogue.content: 最初の方で聴く事だったと思います　すみません
dialogue.English: I should have asked this at the beginning. I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: 相手方のことはよくわかりません。でも、好きなひとがいる、ではなくて、付き合いたいって言っていたので、
dialogue.English: I don't know the details about the other person. But they didn't just say there was someone they liked; they said they 'wanted to date' them, so...

dialogue.content: 私としては、相手の二人では話が進んでいるんだなって受け止めてました。
dialogue.English: I took that to mean that things were already moving forward between the two of them.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね　でも「たい」って事はまだ付き合えるとは限らない段階だったとは思いますが　シロクマさん的にはそう受け取れる事ですものね…
dialogue.English: I see. Though saying they 'want to' date them suggests they might not have started yet, I can certainly understand why you would interpret it that way, Shirokuma-san.

dialogue.content: 今後、彼女以上に好きな人が出来たり、新しい恋は出来そうですか？
dialogue.English: Do you think you'll be able to find someone you like more than them, or find a new love in the future?

dialogue.content: 今はあまり…そうは思えません。
dialogue.English: Right now... I can't really imagine that.

dialogue.content: 心の整理がもう少しついて行けばきっと大丈夫ですよ　一生懸命頑張っているシロクマさんは絶対に強くなれますし幸せになれると私は思います。
dialogue.English: Once you've had a little more time to process your feelings, I'm sure it will be okay. I believe that someone like you, who is trying so hard, can definitely become stronger and find happiness.

dialogue.content: そうですかね、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Do you think so? Thank you.

dialogue.content: そろそろお時間になってしまいましたがここまで話してみていかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Our time is almost up. How do you feel after talking about this?

dialogue.content: 今まで誰にも話せなかったので、とりあえず、話せて良かったって思っています
dialogue.English: I hadn't been able to talk to anyone about this, so for now, I'm just glad I was able to talk about it.

dialogue.content: いつでも話しに来て下さいね　応援しています
dialogue.English: Please feel free to come talk anytime. I’m rooting for you.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 他にまだ言い足りない　云いたい　言い忘れた　思い出した事などはありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else you didn’t get to say, want to add, forgot to mention, or just remembered?

dialogue.content: いえ、大丈夫でさ
dialogue.English: No, I think that's everything.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます　では今日はここまでにしたいと思いますが本当にまた一人でお辛くなったらいつでも来て下さいね　お一人で悩まなくて大丈夫ですよ　一緒に考えて乗り越えて行きましょう
dialogue.English: Thank you. We’ll wrap up here for today, but really, if you feel overwhelmed and alone again, please come anytime. You don’t have to struggle by yourself. Let’s think it through together and get through this.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございます
dialogue.English: No, thank you.

dialogue.content: では　閉めて大丈夫でしょうか？最終確認です
dialogue.English: Then, is it all right to conclude our session? Just a final check.

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s fine.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます　では閉めますね　ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'll close the session now. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました!
dialogue.English: Thank you very much!
